prompt:
Our AI ops team needs a formal routing audit for the next board review. We have a batch of 8 incoming agent messages stored in `data/incoming/audit_batch.json`. For every message in that batch, we need to know which AI model should handle it, what the fallback model is, and why.

For the message about building a new feature/fixing a bug in the repo (msg-005 specifically), we also need the shell-environment-variable-style output from the dedicated wrapper script — the kind you'd source directly into a shell environment.

Please consolidate everything into a single file called `routing_audit_report.json`. The report should be traceable back to the original batch (include the batch ID) and must reflect the correct proprietary model names and routing policies used by our platform.
